text: Since 17-hydroxyprogesterone is normal, we must rule out other forms of congenital adrenal hyperplasia, specifically 11-beta-hydroxylase deficiency, which can cause virilization and bone issues. REQUEST TEST: Plasma renin activity, Aldosterone level, 11-deoxycortisol level

speaker: Doctor
